method: three independent adjudicators, 7 scripts each, given the Pine source and the UCT result but not the desired answer; no adjudicator saw another's verdicts
finding: All three MISLEADING verdicts are the same failure mode, found independently by two adjudicators: acceptance resting on a contentless output after every meaningful series was correctly refused.
corroborated_strength: Both adjudicators volunteered that the refusal machinery is sound - every var/:=/self-reference/loop-carried value in all 21 scripts was refused with a named guard rather than folded to a plausible number.
